title: Selenium WebDriver 4 — Runnable Login Test Suite
title_es: Selenium WebDriver 4 — suite de tests de login ejecutable
description: Runnable companion for the Selenium WebDriver 4 guide: a self-contained HTML fixture app plus a pytest suite exercising Page Object Model, explicit waits, relative locators, window handles and alerts in headless Chrome.
description_es: Companion ejecutable de la guía de Selenium WebDriver 4: una app HTML fixture autocontenida más una suite pytest que ejercita Page Object Model, explicit waits, localizadores relativos, manejo de ventanas y alertas en Chrome headless.
